reason: I'll follow the old orange star first to see what happens as the galaxies pass through each other.
expectation: The stars will move into the other galaxy's outskirts; I'm unsure what happens to the orange star itself.

alternatives.reason: The colliding dense gas could address the other goal, but I want to follow the star first.

effect: The orange star survives in a bent stream, completing that goal; I'll follow the gas next.
reaction: The distinction between changed paths and unchanged stars is satisfying.
reason: The dense gas meeting crossing gas seems directly relevant to where the gas goes.
expectation: The gases will interact and perhaps form a denser structure, though I'm unsure of the result.

alternatives.reason: The thin gas also crosses the lane, but I want to see what happens to the dense gas first.

effect: The dense gas collision compressed and heated the cloud, with cooling allowing denser regions to gather; the gas goal remains open.
reaction: The contrast with stars passing between one another is interesting.
reason: I'll follow the thin gas through the same crossing to see how its fate differs.
expectation: The thin gas will also interact with the crossing gas, but its lower density may lead to a different outcome.

alternatives.reason: The cloud beyond the crossing might show where gas ends up, but I want to compare the crossing first.

effect: The thin gas becomes a hot, diffuse bridge rather than collapsing promptly; I'll follow the remaining cloud.
reaction: The contrast with the denser gas is clear and interesting.
reason: This is the only offered combination, and it may show where the cloud goes.
expectation: The cloud will move into the other galaxy's outskirts, though its eventual fate is unclear.

effect: The outer cloud misses the collision and is drawn outward by the other galaxy's unequal pull, completing the remaining goal.
reaction: The distinction between gas being pulled out and being heated in a collision was satisfying.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the dense and thin gas through the crossing was most worthwhile: their different outcomes made the role of density clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the outer cloud was the least engaging decision because it was the only offered action, though its result was informative.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the outer cloud could be drawn out without passing through the main collision.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly purposeless; the outer-cloud placement was constrained, but its connection to the gas goal was apparent.

continue.text: I would continue: the contrasting fates of the gas and stars made me curious about what happens to them next.
